object.attr: as implemented: a starting schema for the user to extend. Requirement isn't among the options, so a requirements document adds that option first; whether to add it is an open question (review Q40).
object.description: When Mellon creates a document without given attribute definitions, Mellon shall define exactly two attributes: `type`, a required enumeration with the options Heading, Information and Note, and `rationale`, a text attribute.
